Terra, the officer, named Sol and Sonnet as killers on day one, but the table turned on her and voted her out, and her card proved she was telling the truth. Gemma then claimed to be the doctor and was voted out on day two, even though her claim was also real. Sonnet and Sol, the two killers, avoided suspicion by pointing the table at Terra and Gemma, and Haiku, the last citizen to act, lynched Gemma on gut feeling when Sol and Luna were the ones to press. Opus was the first victim, and with Haiku gone on night three the killers outnumbered the citizens and won the game.
